item.title: Chicago Fire allow pair of second-half goals and lose to Houston Dynamo 2-1 in season opener
item.description: Guilherme Santos scored two second-half goals of his MLS debut to rally the Houston Dynamo to a 2-1 victory over the Chicago Fire in a season opener on Saturday night.

item.title: Seguridad Nacional suspende los programas de seguridad aeroportuaria TSA PreCheck y Global Entry
item.description: Associated Press WASHINGTON (AP) — El Departamento de Seguridad Nacional de Estados Unidos suspenderá los programas de seguridad aeroportuaria TSA PreCheck y Global Entry mientras continúa un cierre parcial del gobierno.
